name: QiYi Fisher Cube (Tiled - Icy Amber)
description: The QiYi Fisher Cube (Tiled – Icy Amber) takes the classic 3x3 design and adds a unique twist with its rotated layers. This shape-mod puzzle shifts the standard cube into a diagonal, jumbled configuration, creating an exciting challenge for solvers. The semi-transparent icy amber tiles give it a captivating, crystal-clear appearance, while maintaining a traditional color scheme for easy identification of pieces.
